thread:
julia: question for the console folks  - can we expose adaptive sampling knobs per-rule so we don't burn storage during noisy spikes?
julia: current ask: teams want enough data to triage but not pay for full payload capture.
dave: yeah. two modes: static (fixed %) and adaptive (baseline + bump on burst). UI should show the expected monthly cost delta.
dave: for adaptive, controls: baseline_rate, bump_rate, burst_threshold (errors/min), bump_duration.
paul: important: sampling decisions must include the fallback reason and policy id so replay service can reconstruct. add fields for model_variant and kv_snapshot_keys.
paul: suggest returning header X-Audit-Sampled: 1|decision_id to gate heavy captures.
security-bot: reminder: storing sampled payloads requires tenant-level opt-out + automated redaction defaults. retention must be configurable.
julia: ui idea: inline mini-chart next to each rule showing "expected samples/min" and "estimated storage/hr" based on recent QPS.
dave: add an "apply preset" menu (low/medium/high forensic) so PMs can set sane defaults.
paul: backend detail: evaluate sampling before tokenization and emit sample_decision proto to tracing layer. also emit metric audit.sample.allowed and audit.sample.dropped (quota).
julia: how do we handle quota overflow? we should fallback to probabilistic backoff and mark dropped traces with a reason code.
dave: agree. represent that in telemetry: dropped_by_quota and overflow_backoff_factor. dashboard tile should surface both.
paul: replay requirements: if include_payload=false we still need prompt_hash + kv_keys + model_variant + deterministic_seed to replay in sandbox. if include_payload=true store encrypted payload with KMS envelope.
security-bot: encryption + tenant-optout default: payload capture off. when enabled, retention must default to 7d unless tenant requests longer. PII redaction pipeline must run before storage.
julia: mock config snippet for console/SDKs:
```yaml
policy_id: rollout-77
rules:
  - id: rr-1
    match: response.status == 500
    fallback: use_small_model
    sampling:
      mode: adaptive
      baseline_rate: 0.0005
      bump_rate: 0.05
      burst_threshold_per_min: 20
      bump_duration_s: 600
      include_payload: false
      retention_days: 7
```
dave: UX: add a "simulate" action that projects samples and cost over 24h and warns if projected samples/hr > storage_quota. also show why adaptive would trigger (preview of error-rate timeline).
paul: API contract: sampling decision proto should include decision_id, effective_rate, trigger_reason, policy_id, trace_id. header: X-Audit-Decision: <id>|<effective_rate>|<reason>.
julia: ops: when a P0 is declared, auto-promote bump_rate to forensic preset for affected policies for 1h and post to #oncall. also create a one-click "snapshot now" to force-capture 100 traces for diagnostics.
paul: for fairness across tenants, we should enforce global sampling budget per-region. if exhausted, apply graceful degradation: reduce bump_rate proportionally and emit audit.quota.throttled events.
dave: implementation note: sampling code needs to be extremely cheap; do it at edge before heavy compute. store sample decision in request metadata for downstream services.
deploy-bot: test run scheduled: audit-sample-stress-1719 at 2024-05-12T03:00:00Z. results will be posted to #eng-platform.
security-bot: filed a follow-up for retention & redaction checklist: SEC-3314.
julia: next steps: dave will prototype UI frames, paul will spec header & proto, security-bot will draft redaction defaults. i'll assemble an RFC by EOD Thursday.
dave: will post Figma links when ready.
paul: I'll open PR for sampling header contract.
julia: thanks all. reconvene after RFC. :rocket:
